name: O Rosal
terms: Denominación de Origen Calificada, a step above DO for regions with a record of consistent quality. Only Rioja and Priorat hold it.
Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
A single-estate wine of high quality. A pago is a vineyard estate.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

notes: Rías Baixas Albariño has complex aromas of citrus, flowers and fruit, with apple standing out.
On the palate it is balanced and fresh, with good structure, some richness and a floral, fruity finish.
Cool, damp weather and poor, sandy soils give wines known more for their acidity and aroma than their alcohol.
Barrel-aged whites add toast, smoke, vanilla and nutty notes.
The reds are light in body and moderately tannic, with red berry and herbal aromas.

blurb.text: A wine area within Rías Baixas, the Galician DO known for white wine from the Albariño grape. Rías Baixas also allows Godello, Loureira and Caíño Blanco for white, and Mencía, Espadeiro and Caíño Tinto for red.
